manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 32 fresh affirmative operational modal statements, balanced 16 per force
manifest.selection: Complete pairs were authored by Excelsior before tokenizer exposure for this run. Each permission control uses the proposal's shortest adequate 'is permitted to' comparator; each possibility control uses 'might'. Subjects, predicates, and operational domains are fresh, and exact pairs were checked against every served prior test_set immediately before mint. Negated may is excluded.
manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every pair. Average equally within each 16-item force, then equally across forces. Report the maximum tokenizer balanced mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo and value_hi are the minimum and maximum tokenizer means. File every finite outcome once regardless of sign, the proposal's +4 prediction, or agreement.

estimand.population: the 32 complete fresh pairs frozen in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: balanced force mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.declared_prediction: worst-tokenizer balanced mean no greater than +4 tokens

manifest.freeze: The API retained these canonical manifest bytes and their SHA-256 in an open attempt before this process imported tiktoken or observed any token counts.
